body: I constantly keep forgetting to do items on a given day be it today or in the future. This inbuilt app on IOS is my go to app and one of the most used app on a daily basis. title: 4 stars
body: The widgets of the Reminders app are trash. The reason why I gave it only 4 stars. The widget doesn’t refresh, marked items come back to the list sometimes, and when I mark a scheduled reminder, it sometimes marks the same reminder for multiple days scheduled. This isn’t just on iOS, this is on macOS too. Apple software team (not just Reminders), the red alert is on whether you see or not. Your software is becoming worst from bad in the past.
